title: Interpolate actual-class pairs with finitely many binary word powers
statement: Accepted DDB1 fixed-control threshold guards, normalization shifts and lattice tests give a GLOBAL effective Presburger predicate Psi_R(x,y). For disjoint p,q>=0 and c>=0 with p+q nonzero, the componentwise-minimal triples satisfying Psi_R(c+p,c+q) are finite COMPUTABLE by Dickson and Presburger elimination. Compile fixed original forward/backward words for each minimal(a,u,v). For any class pair x,y, some such triple satisfies u<=(x-y)+,v<=(y-x)+,a<=min(x,y). Translate the word and repeat it the maximal binary exponent allowed by n*u<=(x-y)+ and n*v<=(y-x)+. If D_R bounds compiled differences, at most d(D_R+1) such word powers are needed: each maximal repetition first brings some difference below D_R or changes one already below D_R. Endpoints stay in the coordinate box between x,y; intermediate overshoot is only a compiled fixed constant. Construction has polynomial COMPLETE-BINARY cost, while physical jump count may be enormous. This stronger class geometry does not itself bound inverse activity heights.
